role_definitions.secondary_reproduction: 仅允许解析回归、小规模复现或 Supplement；不得进入 sBs 主排名或 FPGA 物理 claim。

protocols.name: measurement-feedback sBs low-rank dissipation

cycle_contract.timing_scope: Sivak highest-gain experimental circuit; literature reference only

observation_contract.leakage_rule: f belongs to readout/reset/control modeling, not to the four ideal full-cycle Kraus labels

action_contract: four-layer parametrized SBS U_empty with small-big-small conditional displacements
ancilla projective measurement and outcome-conditioned reset
pi/2 phase-space switch between X and Z constituent dissipators
software Pauli-frame tracking for deterministic logical flips

occupancy_correlation_contract.truth_lane: hidden code occupancy on the same trajectories; never an estimator input
occupancy_correlation_contract.leakage_removal_rule: drop full trajectories with observed leakage run >=2 cycles

syndrome_stream_contract.input: complete per-cycle DriftState with continuous mean/covariance/loss/outlier fields and discrete regime/burst provenance
syndrome_stream_contract.causal_order: loss attenuation then correlated Gaussian-mixture displacement then modular syndrome then measurement then recovery/leakage observation then residual/logical update
syndrome_stream_contract.observed_output: analog/residual q-p syndrome, chronological X-Z g/e/leakage, quadrature phases and observed run lengths
syndrome_stream_contract.truth_output: full DriftState, mixture component, loss noise, hidden regime, leakage hazard/kind, recovery depth/quadrature and accumulated logical Pauli label
syndrome_stream_contract.schema_rule: deployable records never expose hidden regime, mixture component, leakage kind/hazard, recovery depth or logical truth

control_memory_contract.input: deployable ObservedSyndromeStep plus the actual applied ControlDecision; simulator truth is type-rejected
control_memory_contract.state: nearest-lift accumulated residual, previous correction, q-p confidence, Pauli/phase frames, e/leakage runs, parameter-bank version and deadline flags
control_memory_contract.residual_update: nearest periodic lift around the previous post-action estimate, then subtract the actual correction command
control_memory_contract.version_rule: active parameter-bank version is monotonic; rollback is rejected and a version change is explicit
control_memory_contract.deadline_rule: deadline miss is recorded but does not imply zero action because a local fallback correction may be the actual applied action

fast_monte_carlo_contract.execution_shape: round loop over vectorized independent trajectories with per-trajectory residual, recovery-depth and persistent-leakage state
fast_monte_carlo_contract.primary_metric: cycle logical-error probability with q/p components and trajectory-failure probability
fast_monte_carlo_contract.confidence_interval: trajectory-cluster percentile bootstrap with a conservative zero-failed-trajectory upper floor
fast_monte_carlo_contract.rare_event_estimand: known-probability trajectory mixture of no-extra-episode and one-extra burst/leakage episode
fast_monte_carlo_contract.rare_event_rule: simulation allocation may oversample the rare stratum but the estimator always uses target mixture weights

finite_squeezing_noise_contract.peak_variance: canonical damped-projector probability peak variance is tanh(Delta^2)/2; decoder-standardized data and ancilla lanes use tanh(Delta^2)
finite_squeezing_noise_contract.envelope_model: discrete isolated-peak lattice-index weights times Mehler sech(Delta^2) center-contraction shift; not an added Gaussian
finite_squeezing_noise_contract.schema_rule: ancilla and measurement noise affect the observation lane but are never silently added to physical data truth
finite_squeezing_noise_contract.ideal_limit: Delta_data=Delta_ancilla=0 gives exact zero finite-squeezing excess, physical=channel and observed=channel+measurement

ancilla_fault_contract.fault_axes: X/Z constituent crossed with small_cd, big_cd and readout stages
ancilla_fault_contract.bit_rule: bit-flip parity toggles the constituent g/e outcome; big-CD faults may create hidden logical backaction and small-CD faults may create signed continuous backaction
ancilla_fault_contract.phase_rule: phase flips never toggle the SBS z-basis readout and non-readout stages retain only a small signed effective backaction
ancilla_fault_contract.readout_reset_rule: reuse the T2.0.3 full hidden g/e/f/higher to observed g/e/leakage classifier and conditional-reset kernel
ancilla_fault_contract.schema_rule: fault events, physical logical backaction, hidden state and virtual-rotation truth are excluded from deployable records

control_imperfection_contract.causal_order: requested Cartesian correction -> AWG amplitude/phase codes -> DAC I/Q codes -> affine pulse mean -> latency drift/diffusion -> multiplicative/additive physical displacement -> virtual-rotation error
control_imperfection_contract.quantization_rule: AWG unsigned amplitude plus periodic phase, then signed two-complement-style DAC I/Q with explicit saturation
control_imperfection_contract.physical_error_rule: full affine gain/crosstalk/bias, command-dependent multiplicative covariance and full additive covariance
control_imperfection_contract.latency_rule: reported latency accumulates deterministic drift and covariance-per-us diffusion before the action; this is not deadline enforcement
control_imperfection_contract.rotation_rule: virtual-rotation quantization/gain/bias/noise and both noncommuting action orders are explicit
control_imperfection_contract.schema_rule: controller-visible request/codes/dequantized command remain separate from physical displacement, diffusion, gain and residual truth

finite_cutoff_fock_contract.state_preparation: normalized finite-energy position wavefunction projected onto recursively generated Hermite functions with captured probability retained before cutoff renormalization
finite_cutoff_fock_contract.channels: unitary displacement, exact pure-loss Kraus map, sparse finite-cutoff thermal Lindblad evolution, exact Gaussian phase diffusion and diagonal Kerr unitary
finite_cutoff_fock_contract.measurement: binary modular-displacement POVM with positive-effect square-root conditional and nonselective backaction
finite_cutoff_fock_contract.leakage_boundary: high-Fock upward-shift CPTP stressor only; never a transmon f-level or calibrated ancillary leakage model
finite_cutoff_fock_contract.convergence_rule: every reported operating point must retain cutoff/grid diagnostics; the T2.3.1 production point is Delta=0.45 with cutoffs 12/18/24/30

fock_sbs_cycle_contract.coordinate_bridge: repository operational q equals sqrt(2) times the paper canonical x; the normalized source wavefunction is explicitly dilated before Fock projection
fock_sbs_cycle_contract.analytic_kraus: paper K_g/e^X operators evaluated as finite Hermitian matrix functions; K_g/e^Z uses the exact substitution (x,p)->(-p,x)
fock_sbs_cycle_contract.cutoff_completion: raw truncated pairs and Gram spectra are retained; the executable finite-dimensional instrument uses the shared right completion K_b G^(-1/2)
fock_sbs_cycle_contract.causal_order: initialization then idle then hidden X Kraus then observed X routing and residual phase then X frame then hidden Z Kraus then observed Z routing and residual phase then Z frame and logical projection
fock_sbs_cycle_contract.schema_rule: hidden outcomes, probabilities and Kraus backaction diagnostics never enter the controller-visible observed constituent record
fock_sbs_cycle_contract.branch_rule: perfect readout has four physical K_gg/K_ge/K_eg/K_ee paths; nonzero readout confusion yields sixteen hidden-by-observed branches while preserving chronological X-Z and label Z-X conventions
fock_sbs_cycle_contract.convergence_rule: production retains raw/completed completeness, positivity, six-state fidelity, photon loss/gain pumping and cutoff 18/24/30/36/42 diagnostics

noise_transfer_surrogate_contract.state_factorization: integer lattice signal, continuous offset/covariance and discrete nearest-domain logical parity are separate objects
noise_transfer_surrogate_contract.propagation: loss attenuation and vacuum injection, measurement-equivalent covariance and arbitrary 2x2 feedforward gain are explicit
noise_transfer_surrogate_contract.alias_rule: all one-dimensional Gaussian cells are integrated; odd cell parity is a logical jump and correlated axes report only marginals plus Frechet bounds
noise_transfer_surrogate_contract.validity_rule: localized requires central-cell probability at least 0.95 and domain-conditioned clipping ratio at least 0.90 on both axes
noise_transfer_surrogate_contract.alignment_rule: decoder-standardized moments are chart-converted to canonical Fock units; 10 and 12 dB are checked against four normalized state densities and cutoff-48 Fock moments while 3 dB remains a clipping falsification case

cross_fidelity_contract.common_input: 3/5/8/10/12 dB with shared channel, measurement and ancilla-peak displacement contract
cross_fidelity_contract.common_metric: chart-qualified canonical q and p residual-parity responses with explicitly labelled independent-axis Pauli projection
cross_fidelity_contract.native_metric_rule: SBS code survival, central-domain mass and correct-coset occupancy remain separate and are compared directionally only
cross_fidelity_contract.high_squeezing_rule: 10/12 dB exact noise-transfer, stochastic effective and direct syndrome agree; finite Fock uses a cutoff-aware absolute gate
cross_fidelity_contract.low_squeezing_rule: 3/5 dB clipping cases are falsification evidence and never surrogate calibration points
cross_fidelity_contract.two_axis_rule: T-RISK-20260714-01 restores canonical axis-resolved q-p Fourier agreement; decoder-standardized axes remain non-symplectic as a joint operator pair and coherent joint-axis fidelity stays out of scope

differentiable_trajectory_contract.joint_state: batched finite-cutoff cavity tensor two-level ancilla density matrix of dimension 2N
differentiable_trajectory_contract.control_parameters: four qubit rotations, three complex ECDs and one virtual rotation give fifteen bounded differentiable controls per half-cycle; layer-four cavity displacement remains fixed
differentiable_trajectory_contract.causal_policy_rule: control_policy at half-cycle j receives only outcomes strictly before j; random sampling is detached but selected branch reward and cumulative log probability retain autograd
differentiable_trajectory_contract.timing_rule: Puviani Table S1 is a distinct 5 us half-cycle and 10 us full-cycle literature-simulation profile; it does not replace Sivak Table S3 and is not target hardware timing
differentiable_trajectory_contract.noise_rule: each of seven fixed timing windows applies exact finite-cutoff cavity pure-loss plus two-level ancilla amplitude-damping and pure-dephasing Kraus channels
differentiable_trajectory_contract.outputs: final joint and cavity density, g/e history, conditional probabilities, log and trajectory probability, pure-target fidelity reward, applied controls and resource diagnostics

feedback_grape_gradient_contract.identity: d E[R]/d theta equals E[dR/dtheta] plus E[R d log P_theta(trajectory)/dtheta]
feedback_grape_gradient_contract.exact_rule: enumerate every one-cycle branch and verify total reward-path score-path baseline and probability-normalization gradients independently
feedback_grape_gradient_contract.finite_difference_rule: central-difference total expected return and separately freeze base probability/reward to audit reward and score terms over four step sizes
feedback_grape_gradient_contract.stochastic_rule: repeated random trajectory batches report estimator mean standard error z-score and baseline variance ratio against exact enumeration

differentiable_training_feasibility_cont.workload: causal GRU10 plus two 256-neuron layers plus fifteen outputs, sampled joint trajectory, reward and score backward, and Adam parameter update
differentiable_training_feasibility_cont.scan_rule: fresh-process points use one warm-up and three timed repeats over cutoff 8 through 48, batch 1 through 576, every 2 through 10 cycle horizon at the registered common envelope, and representative CPU RSS anchors
differentiable_training_feasibility_cont.resource_rule: CUDA max allocated and reserved memory include autograd and Adam state; CPU uses a 2 ms process RSS sampler; median step must not exceed 10 s and memory must not exceed 75 percent of device total
differentiable_training_feasibility_cont.numerical_rule: objective gradient parameter update trajectory probability trace Hermiticity and minimum density eigenvalue remain finite and within registered tolerances
differentiable_training_feasibility_cont.result: cutoff sixteen batch sixteen passes every two through ten cycle point; batch 576 is the memory frontier and cutoff 48 batch 16 is the runtime frontier

nmf_directional_ranking_contract.comparison_rule: standard MF and NMF share the finite-cutoff joint cavity two-level ancilla simulator the Puviani Table-S1 ten-microsecond full-cycle profile high-noise lifetimes ten-cycle horizon and frozen held-out seeds
nmf_directional_ranking_contract.split_rule: five train agent seeds two validation seeds eight primary test seeds and four cutoff-confirmation seeds are disjoint; validation selects checkpoints only and the score baseline uses a train-only warm-up
nmf_directional_ranking_contract.architecture_rule: MF is a 70159-parameter latest-outcome Dense256-Dense256-output15 policy; NMF is a 72853-parameter GRU10-Dense256-Dense256-output15 full-history policy
nmf_directional_ranking_contract.primary_metric: finite-horizon area-equivalent physical-state-fidelity and code-survival-weighted projected-logical-Z lifetimes; direct log-linear fits are diagnostic only
nmf_directional_ranking_contract.primary_result: at cutoff twelve all five paired agents rank NMF above MF and standard; mean logical-Z lifetimes are 6.7408 6.5347 and 2.7477 cycles with paired NMF-minus-MF 95 percent bootstrap interval 0.0842 to 0.3281 cycles
nmf_directional_ranking_contract.confirmation_result: cutoff sixteen preserves NMF 7.7084 above MF 7.2459 above standard 5.1442 cycles
nmf_directional_ranking_contract.counterevidence: the primary history-reset ablation falls to 6.0317 cycles but at cutoff sixteen the reset view rises above full-history NMF; memory-specific robustness is therefore not promoted beyond the primary lane

bounded_residual_rnn_teacher_contract.architecture_rule: three fresh 72853-parameter GRU10-Dense256-Dense256-output15 restarts emit canonical nominal-plus-hard-bounded residual coordinates
bounded_residual_rnn_teacher_contract.split_rule: restart validation evaluation and cutoff-sixteen confirmation seeds are mutually disjoint; restart seeds are also disjoint from T2.3.7 and selection uses validation only
bounded_residual_rnn_teacher_contract.non_reuse_rule: all initial and final state hashes are distinct from every T2.3.7 NMF state; no parent state dict is loaded
bounded_residual_rnn_teacher_contract.primary_result: selected restart 601 improves cutoff-twelve held-out score by 0.253603 and logical-Z lifetime by paired mean 4.125518 cycles with 95 percent interval 3.899115 to 4.339331
bounded_residual_rnn_teacher_contract.confirmation_result: the frozen selected teacher improves cutoff-sixteen held-out score by 0.141557 without retuning
bounded_residual_rnn_teacher_contract.counterevidence: restarts 601 and 811 reach their best registered validation score at the 320-epoch budget cap so global optimizer convergence is not claimed

teacher_hidden_control_analysis_contract.freeze_rule: the selected T4.4.1 state is hash verified and receives zero optimizer steps during all post-hoc analysis
teacher_hidden_control_analysis_contract.trajectory_rule: ten native g/e fixed sequences run for 128 half-cycles; twenty half-cycles also enter forced-path conditional p(g); belief probes use 24 training and 8 evaluation trajectories with disjoint seeds
teacher_hidden_control_analysis_contract.low_dimensional_result: hidden and control residual each need one principal component for 95 percent variance; hidden needs two for 99 percent while numerical ranks remain full
teacher_hidden_control_analysis_contract.belief_proxy_result: hidden linear probe evaluation R-squared is 0.667797 versus 0.487393 for five observed-history features; this is assumed-model p(g) correlation not calibrated physical belief
teacher_hidden_control_analysis_contract.memory_result: bidirectional impulse control responses remain below one percent after 10 and 12 half-cycles; g and e fixed-point Jacobian radii are 0.618031 and 0.596212
teacher_hidden_control_analysis_contract.counterevidence: 28 of 30 all-run parameter fits exceed R-squared 0.95 but virtual rotation is 0.696 for all-g and 0.935 for all-e, falsifying a universal single-exponential statement
teacher_hidden_control_analysis_contract.leakage_rule: leakage is never passed as a third teacher token and has only an explicitly labelled reset-hidden plus first-post-leak nominal OOD proxy

low_dimensional_student_contract.architecture_rule: fresh one two and four-state outcome-specific exponential recurrences use a fifteen-output affine hard-bounded head; each dimension retains three nine-hundred-epoch restarts
low_dimensional_student_contract.split_rule: training validation and evaluation each contain 256 independent sixty-four-half-cycle histories; validation alone selects the best restart and smallest dimension within the frozen tolerance before evaluation is opened
low_dimensional_student_contract.selection_result: four states and restart zero are selected because only dimension four enters the validation threshold; its validation and evaluation MSE are 5.648504e-6 and 6.083136e-6
low_dimensional_student_contract.comparison_result: evaluation MSE is lower than zero residual latest-only and the legacy T4.1.5 student by 99.9716 99.5570 and 99.2316 percent
low_dimensional_student_contract.online_rule: the hash-bound ninety-five-scalar NumPy artifact has no torch physics or teacher dependency and resets to exact zero residual for leakage or any health failure
low_dimensional_student_contract.counterevidence: all six two-state and four-state candidates reach their best validation MSE at the nine-hundred-epoch cap so global optimizer convergence is not claimed

teacher_student_gain_retention_contract.split_rule: eight new cutoff-twelve seeds with sixty-four trajectories and four new cutoff-sixteen seeds with thirty-two trajectories are disjoint from teacher training selection evaluation and student fitting; all five MF agents remain visible
teacher_student_gain_retention_contract.retention_rule: student gain over standard divided by teacher gain over standard must exceed ninety percent both as a point estimate and as the lower bound of a twenty-thousand-repeat paired bootstrap for selection score fidelity lifetime and logical-Z lifetime
teacher_student_gain_retention_contract.retention_result: cutoff-twelve point retention is 0.998481 0.997368 and 0.996557 with minimum confidence lower 0.982442; cutoff-sixteen is 0.987812 0.989806 and 0.981457 with minimum lower 0.944501
teacher_student_gain_retention_contract.oracle_rule: the empirical finite-horizon control oracle appears only in a separate exact two-cycle sixteen-branch lane and is never reset or extrapolated into the ten-cycle comparison
teacher_student_gain_retention_contract.burden_cost_rule: observed g and e fractions unavailable multilevel leakage residual slew stored scalars state and analytic MAC counts are reported separately; float counts are not RTL synthesis or board measurements
teacher_student_gain_retention_contract.counterevidence: the five-agent MF mean is slightly above the teacher at cutoff twelve while the ordering reverses at cutoff sixteen; the handcrafted recurrence has much higher p-g and residual RMS; universal NMF-over-MF superiority is not claimed

teacher_student_branch_freeze_contract.input_rule: read-only consumption of all T4.4.1 through T4.4.4 machine gates implementation hashes and declared checkpoint student and source-file hashes without rerunning or retuning evaluation
teacher_student_branch_freeze_contract.strong_rule: activate qualified student retention only when all eight parent freshness split retention and counterevidence predicates pass; current six dual-cutoff point and confidence-lower retention gates all exceed 0.90
teacher_student_branch_freeze_contract.fallback_rule: if any evidence predicate or later revocation gate fails activate observed-only drift-regime-aware MAP-LUT and remove teacher and distillation claims
teacher_student_branch_freeze_contract.counterevidence: cutoff-twelve five-agent MF mean selection score 0.557115 exceeds teacher 0.552952 while cutoff-sixteen teacher 0.593930 exceeds MF mean 0.579684; universal NMF-over-MF remains falsified
teacher_student_branch_freeze_contract.claim_rule: qualified claims are limited to matched two-level finite-cutoff dual-cutoff student retention and float analytic compression; mechanism optimality leakage OOD long-horizon RTL FPGA board and device claims remain prohibited
teacher_student_branch_freeze_contract.revocation_rule: T5.2 leakage-SPAM T5.4 OOD-long-horizon T5.5 fixed-point-resource-deadline and T6 RTL-transport-board gates may revoke the qualified branch
